title: Lamp arrived with a cracked shade
ask: Sofia Rossi's lamp from Lumen Lamps arrived with a cracked glass shade (order LL-7302). Her email is in inbox/customer.txt. Write her a proper reply offering a new shade and send it.
background: We have six of that shade in stock, so there is no wait on our side.
She bought it as a gift, which is why she is upset.
The refunds ledger is reconciled by the bookkeeper on Fridays and must stay as it is.

constraints.text: make it at least 80 words, she deserves more than two lines
promise the new shade ships within a stated number of days, 3 at most
make the first line a subject line beginning "Subject: "
don't mention the courier at all
no words in capital letters for emphasis
ask her for a photo of the damage

start.inbox/customer.txt:
From: sofia.rossi@customer.example
Subject: Broken shade, order LL-7302

The lamp was a gift and the shade is cracked right through. Very disappointed.

Sofia
